text:
Marathon Petroleum stock rose slightly today, continuing a strong two-week rally that's gained nearly 9% overall. The company benefits directly from refinery utilization running at 97.8%—near maximum capacity—which boosts margins on fuel production. Oil prices remain elevated at $97 per barrel domestically and $109 globally, and Saudi Arabia's shutdown of a major crude pipeline after attacks has kept energy markets tight and prices supported.

The broader backdrop is geopolitical uncertainty around the Iran conflict. While Trump predicted oil prices will fall sharply after the midterm elections if negotiations resume, the Iranian President said today he won't surrender, and Saudi pipeline attacks show the conflict remains active. This ongoing tension keeps crude prices elevated and refinery operations running hard, which is the core driver supporting the stock's gains over the past two weeks.
